name: Tether
subtitle: An SSH terminal for iPhone and iPad.
description: Tether: a fast, private SSH client. No accounts, no subscriptions; your servers and keys stay on your devices.

apps.name: Tether
apps.subtitle: An SSH terminal for iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription:
Connect to your servers over SSH from your iPhone or iPad.

• Save servers with groups, a startup command (e.g. tmux) and a per-server theme
• Keep several sessions open at once and come back to them with scrollback intact
• Full xterm-256color terminal with an Esc/Ctrl/Tab/arrow key row, mouse support for TUI apps, and clipboard
• Generate Ed25519 or ECDSA keys on the device, or import OpenSSH/PEM keys; private keys live in the Keychain
• Host key verification with a clear warning when a server's key changes
• Clips: one-tap commands in a bar under the terminal, global or per server
• Sync servers, clips and settings through a folder in iCloud Drive; keys and passwords travel alongside, encrypted with your passphrase
• Five themes, adjustable font size, Option as Meta

No accounts, no tracking.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Tether connects to SSH servers on your local network.

versions.localizedDescription: Detaching tmux/byobu or logging out now closes the session instead of showing 'I/O on closed channel'. A non-zero exit keeps the session open with its exit status. Also fixes the passphrase setup dialog closing when you moved to the second field.

Sync: pick a folder in iCloud Drive to keep servers, clips, known hosts and settings in step across devices. Keys and passwords are backed up next to them, encrypted with your passphrase, so a reinstall or a new device only needs the passphrase. Also fixes a crash when opening a connection.
